title: Plastic Honey Bottles
heading: Wholesale Plastic Honey Bottles & Jars
description: Compare PET bear bottles, ribbed squeeze bottles, inverted packs and wide-mouth jars. Start with your intended honey fill weight, then choose a bottle volume and closure that suit your filling line.
points: Choose PET dispensing bottles for serving through a cap, or wide-mouth jars for spoon access.
Select the capacity by target honey net weight and the headspace established in your filling trial.
Specify the matched cap, liner or seal and label requirements when requesting samples and bulk pricing.

title: Glass Honey Jars
heading: Wholesale Glass Honey Jars
description: Explore mini, hexagon and ribbed glass honey jars. Select a shape for your shelf presentation, then review the lid, label space and transit protection together.
points: Compare mini, hexagon and ribbed profiles by shelf footprint and usable label area.
Select a lid and liner for the exact jar finish, then validate the sealing assembly with your filling process.
Include glass dividers, carton quantities and pallet requirements when requesting a shipping quotation.

title: Honey Bear Bottles
heading: Honey Bear Bottles for Bulk Orders
description: A familiar shape with room for a distinctive label. Our PET bear bottles combine a sculpted body with a defined front panel and matching closure options for bulk honey packaging.
points: Compare mini and standard-capacity bear formats by honey fill target, assembled height and grip.
Fit your label within the front panel so the molded face and bear details remain visible.
Choose the matched closure and dispensing opening; confirm cap color and packing quantities in your quote.

title: Honey Squeeze Bottles
heading: Wholesale Honey Squeeze Bottles
description: Ribbed, bear, hexagon and inverted honey squeeze bottles give you different dispensing and label options. Test the bottle and cap together with honey at your intended filling and serving conditions.
points: Choose an upright or cap-down bottle to suit your shelf presentation and serving method.
Evaluate the outlet, squeeze response and any proposed valve using your honey at its intended serving conditions.
Approve cap fit, reclosure and filled-pack leakage checks for the selected bottle and closure.

title: Hexagon Honey Jars
heading: Hexagon Glass Honey Jars for Bulk Orders
description: Flat panels and a six-sided silhouette give honey labels a defined place to sit. Compare the glass jar family by catalog volume and reference honey fill weight.
points: Size labels for each flat face, leaving a margin before the corners.
Match the metal lid and liner to the selected jar finish and filling process.
Approve the assembled jar inside your branded, gift or shipping pack, including separation between glass surfaces.

title: Mini Honey Jars
heading: Mini Honey Jars for Gifts, Favors & Sampling
description: Choose mini glass jars for sampling, gifts and wedding favors. The 25 ml round jar and compact hexagon formats can be reviewed with your label and outer packaging. Honey filling is handled by your business.
points: Select the portion by target honey weight, jar volume and the working fill line.
Check label readability at printed size; consider lid labels or outer-box panels for additional information.
Coordinate the jar, lid and protective insert before confirming gift-box dimensions and shipment quantities.

title: Plastic Honey Jars
heading: Wholesale Plastic Honey Jars with Lids
description: Compare PET honey jars by opening size, body shape, capacity and lid material. Choose wide-mouth, screw-cap or handled formats, with size-specific dimensions and packing information.
points: Compare mouth openings for your filling nozzle and intended spoon access.
Select the matched PP, PE or aluminum cap using the full neck and closure specification.
Approve label placement, the sealing assembly and carton configuration for the selected jar.

title: Inverted Honey Bottles
heading: Inverted Honey Bottles for Cap-Down Dispensing
description: Compare compact and oval inverted honey bottles for bulk orders. Review the bottle, supporting cap and dispensing outlet as one assembly, then test with your honey.
points: Compare the compact and oval bodies by filled-pack stability, grip and label area.
Select a supporting closure for cap-down storage; confirm whether a valve or an open outlet is included.
Test leakage, dispensing and reclosure with your honey before approving the assembled pack.

title: Honey Bottle Caps & Jar Lids
heading: Honey Bottle Caps & Jar Lids for Bulk Orders
description: Compare dispensing caps for squeeze bottles, valve closures for inverted packs, plastic screw caps and metal lids for honey jars. Select the container first, then confirm the complete neck finish, outlet, liner or valve with an assembled sample.
points: Match the closure to the exact bottle or jar neck finish; diameter alone does not confirm compatibility.
Evaluate dispensing outlets, valves, liners and seals with your honey and filling process.
Confirm color, material, application method, packing quantity and the assembled sample in the quotation.
